title: KineNest — Session 1 · Nodes & Topics
steps: Inspect the nodes and list the available topics.
Find the velocity topic and inspect its message type.
Inspect the Twist interface, then publish a single command.
Watch the robot move, then check your solution.
Optional: echo /odom in another terminal to watch pose and velocity change.

title: KineNest — Session 2 · Callbacks & LiDAR
steps: Inspect /scan with topic type and echo --once.
Create a LaserScan subscription and print the number of beams and the forward range.
Run it, observe repeated output, and inspect the subscription using ros2 topic info /scan.

title: KineNest — Session 2 · Callbacks & LiDAR
steps: Ispeziona /scan con topic type ed echo --once.
Crea una subscription LaserScan e stampa il numero di raggi e la distanza frontale.
Esegui, osserva le stampe ripetute e controlla la subscription con ros2 topic info /scan.

title: KineNest — Session 2 · Callbacks & LiDAR
steps: Untersuche /scan mit ros2 topic info und ros2 interface show sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan.
Erstelle eine LaserScan-Subscription und gib Strahlanzahl und Abstand nach vorne aus.
Starte den Knoten, beobachte die Ausgabe und prüfe ros2 topic info /scan.

title: KineNest — Session 3 · Perception & Services
steps: Ispeziona /camera/image_raw con ros2 topic info.
Sottoscrivi Image e stampa msg.width e msg.height nel callback.
Esegui il nodo e controlla le stampe ripetute.

title: KineNest — Session 5 · Odometry & Frames
steps: Ispeziona ros2 topic echo /tf --once. L’albero è odom → base_link → laser_link.
Crea Buffer e TransformListener. Nel timer richiedi lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Riporta translation.x e translation.y con report_transform. Il target_frame è il riferimento in cui vuoi esprimere la risposta.

title: KineNest — Session 3 · Perception & Services
steps: Inspect /camera/image_raw with ros2 topic info.
Subscribe to Image and print msg.width and msg.height in the callback.
Run the node and check the repeated output.

title: KineNest — Session 5 · Odometry & Frames
mission: Where is the target relative to me?
steps: Inspect the actual TF tree panel: world → odom → base_link, plus sensor and target frames.
Look up target with base_link as the target_frame argument.
Report translation.x and .y with report_relative, then compare with the visible target marker.

title: KineNest — Session 6 · Debugging Challenge
steps: Run the supplied program and inspect node list, topic list -t and topic info /cmd_vel.
Find the publisher’s topic and compare it with the simulator’s subscription. Fix the mismatch.
Let the repaired controller avoid the block. Explain which evidence identified the fault.

title: KineNest — Session 5 · Odometry & Frames
steps: Inspect ros2 topic echo /tf --once. The tree is odom → base_link → laser_link.
Create a Buffer and TransformListener. In a timer, request lookup_transform("odom", "laser_link", Time()).
Report translation.x and translation.y using report_transform. The target frame is the frame in which you want the answer.

title: KineNest — Session 1 · Nodes & Topics

Encuentra el topic de velocidad y consulta su tipo de mensaje.
Inspecciona Twist y publica un único comando.
Observa el movimiento y comprueba la solución.
Opcional: observa /odom en otro terminal para ver posición y velocidad.

title: KineNest — Session 3 · Perception & Services
steps: Inspecciona /camera/image_raw con ros2 topic info.
Suscríbete a Image y muestra msg.width y msg.height en el callback.
Ejecuta el nodo y comprueba la salida repetida.

title: KineNest — Session 5 · Odometry & Frames
steps: Inspecciona el árbol TF con world, odom, base_link, sensores y target.
Consulta target usando base_link como target_frame.
Llama a report_relative con translation.x y translation.y y compara con el objetivo visible.

title: KineNest — Session 1 · Nodes & Topics
steps: Untersuche die Knoten und liste die Topics auf.
Finde das Geschwindigkeits-Topic und seinen Nachrichtentyp.
Untersuche Twist und sende einen einzelnen Befehl.
Beobachte die Bewegung und prüfe deine Lösung.
Optional: Beobachte Position und Geschwindigkeit mit echo auf /odom in einem zweiten Terminal.

title: KineNest — Session 3 · Perception & Services
steps: Untersuche /camera/image_raw mit ros2 topic info.
Abonniere Image und gib msg.width und msg.height im Callback aus.
Starte den Knoten und prüfe die wiederholte Ausgabe.

title: KineNest — Session 5 · Odometry & Frames
steps: Untersuche den TF-Baum mit world, odom, base_link, Sensoren und target.
Frage target mit base_link als target_frame ab.
Melde translation.x und translation.y mit report_relative und vergleiche die Zielmarkierung.

Osserva il robot muoversi, poi verifica la soluzione.

Cerca target usando base_link come argomento target_frame.
Riporta translation.x e .y con report_relative e confrontali con il target visibile.
